key.name: auto-detect-cursor
key.description: Automatically detect and extract the active system cursor theme icon.

key.name: custom-cursor-path
key.description: Path to a custom cursor image if auto-detection is disabled.

key.name: cursor-size
key.description: Size in pixels of the magnified cursor.

key.name: hide-original-cursor
key.description: Hide the standard hardware cursor while magnified.

key.name: disable-in-fullscreen
key.description: Disable cursor magnification when a fullscreen window or game is active (e.g. Steam games).

key.name: magnify-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the zoom-in animation.

key.name: unmagnify-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the zoom-out animation.

key.name: unmagnify-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before starting to shrink the cursor.

key.name: sample-size
key.description: Number of movement track samples to analyze.

key.name: distance-threshold
key.description: Minimum distance traversed to trigger magnification.

key.name: radians-threshold
key.description: Minimum angle change threshold to trigger magnification.

key.name: check-interval
key.description: Interval in milliseconds to analyze shake gesture.

key.name: draw-interval
key.description: Interval in milliseconds to update cursor position.
